primary_content.text: Muay Thai classes are 90 minutes. All other classes are 60 minutes. Sundays are Open Gym – you can use the weights area, mats and bags.
All classes run for 90 minutes except for Kettlebells and Conditioning, S&C, MMA Sparring, Bangtao Fit and Fundamental classes which are 1 hour long.
